# The Syndicate

> The Syndicate (https://the-syndicate.com) is an online business education platform.
> It sells lifetime-access programs on money mastery, trading technical analysis,
> agentic AI automation, AI content automation (faceless YouTube), business models,
> and business behaviour psychology. Content is delivered through a member dashboard
> after one-time purchase; there is also a Knight membership tier and an affiliate program.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://the-syndicate.com/): brand overview, elite programs, pricing, FAQ
- [Programs](https://the-syndicate.com/programs): full catalog — Money Mastery vault, Trading Advanced Technical Analysis (Scalpel Protocol, Strategies / Setups / Secrets of a Master Trader), Agentic AI pack, AI Content Automation pack, business model courses
- [What You Get](https://the-syndicate.com/what-you-get): membership benefits and deliverables
- [Our Methods](https://the-syndicate.com/our-methods): teaching doctrine and approach
- [Our Founder](https://the-syndicate.com/our-founder): founder story
- [Membership](https://the-syndicate.com/membership): The Knight tier offer
- [Affiliate](https://the-syndicate.com/affiliate): affiliate / partner program with tracked commissions
- [Quiz](https://the-syndicate.com/quiz): The Syndicate Diagnosis — business archetype audit

## Key facts

- Programs are one-time purchases with lifetime access (no subscription for vault packs).
- Trading Advanced Technical Analysis: $150 full pack, or 4 modules at $50 each, or single lessons.
- Agentic AI and AI Content Automation packs: $150 each full pack, individual courses available.
- Money Mastery bundle: flagship $333 vault.
- Login, dashboard, and checkout areas are private and not for indexing.
